headline: Recommended higher income limits for elderly and disabled tax exemptions and gas, electricity, and natural gas contracts; tabled two parking garage permit amendments.
summary: Recommended a higher income limit for elderly and disabled tax exemptions and contract approvals for gasoline, electricity, and natural gas, including purchasing extensions or renewals. Tabled amendments to parking permits for the High Street and School Street garages, and ordinances O-26-004 and O-26-005 on camping and campers on public property. Also recommended a deputy treasurer/tax collector appointment and two Citizens Advisory Commission re-appointments.
decisions: Accepted the elderly and disabled exemption review communication and placed it on file.
Recommended appointment as Deputy Treasurer/Tax Collector with an indefinite term; motion carried.
Recommended re-appointment of Lisa Tourangeau with a term to expire October 1, 2029, and Jennifer Bishop with a term to expire November 1, 2029; motion carried.
Recommended final passage of O-26-025 increasing the elderly and disabled tax exemption income limits; motion carried.
Recommended final passage of O-26-026 on approvals for gasoline, electricity, and natural gas contracts and purchasing extensions or renewals; motion carried.
Tabled O-27 amendment to parking permits for the High Street Garage; motion to table carried.
Tabled O-26-028 amendment to parking permits for the School Street Parking Garage; motion to table carried.
Tabled O-26-004 repealing the prohibition on camping on public property.
Tabled O-26-005 repealing the prohibition on campers and recreational vehicles on public property.
